[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
You can summon a "Vanity Deity"/"Imaginary Beast" family Spirit card/Ultimate card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, return a Yellow card from your Trash to the Hand.
[utb]

BS27-056.name: Ultimate-Wols
BS27-056.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more White Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Blocks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, when only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by comparing BP, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
[utb]
